# ATP matches data

```{r}
# Get atp_matches data
data(atp_matches)
atp_matches
```

```{r}
# Filter to get completed grand slam matches in years 2011-2022
grand_slam_matches <- atp_matches %>%
  filter(
    tourney_name %in% c("Australian Open", "Roland Garros", "Wimbledon", "US Open"),
    between(year, 2011, 2022),
    (is.na(Retirement) | Retirement == FALSE)
  )
grand_slam_matches
```

```{r}
# Adjust column names and player name formatting
grand_slam_matches <- grand_slam_matches %>%
  mutate(
    winner_name = {
      parts <- str_split(winner_name, " ", simplify = TRUE)
      first <- parts[,1]
      last <- apply(parts[, -1, drop=FALSE], 1, function(x) paste(x[x != ""], collapse = " "))
      paste(last, paste0(str_sub(first, 1, 1), "."))
    },
    loser_name = {
      parts <- str_split(loser_name, " ", simplify = TRUE)
      first <- parts[,1]
      last <- apply(parts[, -1, drop=FALSE], 1, function(x) paste(x[x != ""], collapse = " "))
      paste(last, paste0(str_sub(first, 1, 1), "."))
    }
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Winner = winner_name,
    Loser = loser_name,
    Year = year,
    Tournament = tourney_name
  )
grand_slam_matches
```

```{r}
# Find out number of matches
nrow(grand_slam_matches)
```

```{r}
# Check for duplicate matches
grand_slam_matches %>%
  group_by(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
# Arbitrarily remove one of the duplicates
grand_slam_matches <- grand_slam_matches %>%
  filter(!(Tournament == "Roland Garros" &
           Year == 2013 &
           Winner == "Przysiezny M." &
           Loser == "Williams R." &
           score == "6-3 6-7(5) 7-5 7-5"))
grand_slam_matches
```

```{r}
# Check number of matches after removal
nrow(grand_slam_matches)
```

```{r}
# Verify no duplicate matches
grand_slam_matches %>%
  group_by(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```


# ATP odds data

```{r}
data(atp_odds)
atp_odds
```


```{r}
# Construct odds dataset

# Create year column, ensure correct tournament names, select only needed columns
odds <- atp_odds %>%
  mutate(Year = year(Date),
         Tournament = if_else(Tournament == "French Open", "Roland Garros", Tournament)) %>%
  select(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser, WRank, LRank, AvgW, AvgL, B365W, B365L)

# Filter to obtain grand slam tournaments in the years 2011-2022
odds <- odds %>%
  filter(
    Tournament %in% c("Australian Open", "Roland Garros", "Wimbledon", "US Open"),
    between(Year, 2011, 2022)
  )
odds
```

```{r}
# Find out number of matches
nrow(odds)
```


```{r}
# Check for duplicate matches
odds %>%
  group_by(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# ATP elo rating data

```{r}
data(atp_elo)
atp_elo
```

```{r}
# Ensure each match is only recorded once, not one time for each player
atp_elo_unique <- atp_elo %>%
  mutate(
    player1 = pmin(player_name, opponent_name),
    player2 = pmax(player_name, opponent_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct(tourney_name, tourney_start_date, player1, player2, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Adjust column names
elo <- atp_elo_unique %>%
  mutate(Year = year(tourney_start_date)) %>%
  rename(
    Tournament = tourney_name
  )

# Change from player and opponent to winner and loser format
elo <- elo %>%
  mutate(
    Winner = if_else(win == 1, player_name, opponent_name),
    Loser = if_else(win == 1, opponent_name, player_name),
    Winner_elo = if_else(win == 1, player_before_elo, opponent_before_elo),
    Loser_elo = if_else(win == 1, opponent_before_elo, player_before_elo)
  ) %>%
  select(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser, Winner_elo, Loser_elo)

# Adjust winner and loser names
elo <- elo %>%
  mutate(
    Winner = {
      parts <- str_split(Winner, " ", simplify = TRUE)
      first <- parts[,1]
      last <- apply(parts[, -1, drop=FALSE], 1, function(x) paste(x[x != ""], collapse = " "))
      paste(last, paste0(str_sub(first, 1, 1), "."))
    },
    Loser = {
      parts <- str_split(Loser, " ", simplify = TRUE)
      first <- parts[,1]
      last <- apply(parts[, -1, drop=FALSE], 1, function(x) paste(x[x != ""], collapse = " "))
      paste(last, paste0(str_sub(first, 1, 1), "."))
    }
  )

# Filter to obtain grand slam tournaments in the years 2011-2022
elo <- elo %>%
  filter(
    Tournament %in% c("Australian Open", "Roland Garros", "Wimbledon", "US Open"),
    between(Year, 2011, 2022)
  )
elo
```

```{r}
# Check for duplicate matches
elo %>%
  group_by(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Find out number of matches
nrow(elo)
```

# Combine datasets

```{r}
# Check for matches between grand_slam_matches and odds datasets
matched_with_odds <- grand_slam_matches %>%
  inner_join(
    odds %>% select(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser),
    by = c("Tournament", "Year", "Winner", "Loser")
  )
nrow(matched_with_odds)
```

```{r}
# Check for matches between grand_slam_matches and elo datasets
matched_with_elo <- grand_slam_matches %>%
  inner_join(
    elo %>% select(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser),
    by = c("Tournament", "Year", "Winner", "Loser")
  )
nrow(matched_with_elo)
```

```{r}
# Combine datasets

combined <- grand_slam_matches %>%
  left_join(
    odds %>% select(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser, WRank, LRank, AvgW, AvgL, B365W, B365L),
    by = c("Tournament", "Year", "Winner", "Loser")
  )

combined <- combined %>%
  left_join(
    elo %>% select(Tournament, Year, Winner, Loser, Winner_elo, Loser_elo),
    by = c("Tournament", "Year", "Winner", "Loser")
  )
```

```{r}
combined
```

```{r}
# Convert data type of values in WRank and LRank columns from chr to int
combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(
    WRank = as.integer(WRank),
    LRank = as.integer(LRank)
  )
combined
```

# Construct desired predictors from paper

```{r}
# Set seed to randomly assign Winner or Loser to Player1
set.seed(195)

# Build final dataset
processed_matches <- combined %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Randomly decide whether to swap players
    swap = sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), size = 1),

    # Define Player1 and Player2 depending on swap
    Player1 = ifelse(swap, Loser, Winner),
    Player2 = ifelse(swap, Winner, Loser),

    # Victory: did Player1 win?
    Victory = ifelse(swap, 0, 1),

    # Player1 and Player2 ages
    age1 = ifelse(swap, loser_age, winner_age),
    age2 = ifelse(swap, winner_age, loser_age),

    # Player1 and Player2 ranking points
    points1 = ifelse(swap, loser_rank_points, winner_rank_points),
    points2 = ifelse(swap, winner_rank_points, loser_rank_points),

    # Player1 and Player2 ranks
    rank1 = ifelse(swap, LRank, WRank),
    rank2 = ifelse(swap, WRank, LRank),
    
    # Player1 and Player2 avg odds
    AvgProb1 = ifelse(swap, AvgL, AvgW),
    AvgProb2 = ifelse(swap, AvgW, AvgL),
    
    # Player1 and Player2 bookmaker Bet365 odds
    B365.1 = ifelse(swap, B365L, B365W),
    B365.2 = ifelse(swap, B365W, B365L),
    
    # Player1 and Player2 bookmaker pre-match elo ratings
    elo1 = ifelse(swap, Loser_elo, Winner_elo),
    elo2 = ifelse(swap, Winner_elo, Loser_elo),
    
    # Compute differences
    Age = age1 - age2,
    Points = points1 - points2,
    Rank = rank1 - rank2,
    Elo = elo1 - elo2,
    Prob = AvgProb1 - AvgProb2,

    # Compute Age.30
    Age.30 = (abs(age1 - 30)) - (abs(age2 - 30)),

    # Compute Age.int
    age1_int = ifelse(age1 < 28, abs(age1 - 28),
                      ifelse(age1 > 32, abs(age1 - 32), 0)),
    age2_int = ifelse(age2 < 28, abs(age2 - 28),
                      ifelse(age2 > 32, abs(age2 - 32), 0)),
    Age.int = age1_int - age2_int
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Player1, Player2, Year, Tournament, Surface = surface, Victory, Age, Prob, Rank, Points, Elo, Age.30, Age.int, 
         AvgProb1, AvgProb2, B365.1, B365.2)
```

```{r}
# Filter out rows with NA values
processed_matches <- processed_matches %>%
  drop_na()
```

```{r}
# Check number of matches in dataset
nrow(processed_matches)
```


# Group one-time players into a category called "newcomer"

```{r}
# Identify names of players who only participated in a single grand slam tournament

players_years <- processed_matches %>%
  select(Player1, Tournament, Year) %>%
  rename(Player = Player1) %>%
  bind_rows(
    processed_matches %>%
      select(Player2, Tournament, Year) %>%
      rename(Player = Player2)
  )

# Remove duplicates (multiple matches in same tournament/year)
players_years <- players_years %>%
  distinct(Player, Tournament, Year)

# Count how many distinct (Tournament, Year) combinations each player has
players_tournament_year_counts <- players_years %>%
  count(Player, name = "num_tournaments_years")

# Filter players who only played in one tournament+year
players_single_appearance <- players_tournament_year_counts %>%
  filter(num_tournaments_years <= 1)

players_single_appearance
```

```{r}
# Check identification was done correctly
altmaier_matches <- processed_matches %>%
  filter(Player1 == "Altmaier D." | Player2 == "Altmaier D.")
altmaier_matches
```

```{r}
# Replace names of players who only played in one tournament with the group name "newcomer"
single_appearance_players <- players_single_appearance$Player

# Replace Player1 and Player2 if they are in the list of single_appearance_players
processed_matches <- processed_matches %>%
  mutate(
    Player1 = if_else(Player1 %in% single_appearance_players, "newcomer", Player1),
    Player2 = if_else(Player2 %in% single_appearance_players, "newcomer", Player2)
  )

processed_matches
```

```{r}
# Check newcomer category successfully integrated
"newcomer" %in% unique(c(processed_matches$Player1, processed_matches$Player2))
```

```{r}
# Check number of matches in final dataset
nrow(processed_matches)
```

```{r}
# Save the final dataset
saveRDS(processed_matches, file = "processed_matches.rds")
```
